C21 also discusses a prospective conference invitation and possible acceptance, while C11 shares atomic-energy subject matter and the phrase “source of gratification to me”; these similarities are limited and generic. No candidate contains a concrete, material sequence or sufficiently distinctive shared language indicating reuse as a drafting template.
